name: intelacis Chat Widget
author: intelacis

sections.description:
intelacis is an AI assistant for small businesses. This plugin adds the intelacis chat bubble to every page of your WordPress site, so visitors can ask questions, leave their details and book appointments.

Setup is one field: paste your Business ID under Settings → intelacis Chat Widget and save. The plugin adds nothing to your site until a Business ID is saved.

You need an intelacis account to use this plugin. Sign up at https://intelacis.com.

External service

This plugin connects your site to intelacis, a third-party service run by the plugin author.

  • What is loaded: once a Business ID is saved, every front-end page loads the intelacis widget script from https://app.intelacis.com/widget.js. The script shows the chat bubble and opens the chat window from app.intelacis.com.
  • What is sent: your Business ID (so intelacis knows which business the chat belongs to), the address of the page the chat is on, the names of any other chat tools that page already loads, and the chat messages and any contact details your visitors type into the chat window. Nothing is sent from the WordPress admin, and nothing is sent before a Business ID is saved.
  • Terms of service: https://intelacis.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://intelacis.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New, search for “intelacis Chat Widget”, install and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings → intelacis Chat Widget, paste your Business ID and Save. Find it in your intelacis dashboard under Settings → Widget → Install — it is the data-business-id value in the snippet.
  3. In your intelacis dashboard, add this site’s address under Settings → Widget → Customize → Allowed domains.
sections.faq:
The chat bubble appears but the chat box opens blank

Add your site’s address (for example https://example.com) under Settings → Widget → Customize → Allowed domains in your intelacis dashboard. The chat box only opens on sites listed there.

The chat bubble does not appear

Check that a Business ID is saved under Settings → intelacis Chat Widget. If you use a plugin that delays, combines or minifies JavaScript, exclude app.intelacis.com/widget.js from it.

Does this work on WordPress.com?

Yes, on a WordPress.com plan that allows installing plugins.

Do I need an intelacis account?

Yes. The plugin only adds the chat bubble; the assistant, its answers and your leads live in your intelacis account.
